description: This file defines an interface StatusSupplier used to supply a CompletionStage<JsonObject> representing system status data. It is part of the health status subsystem within the Eclipse Ditto services utility package.

classes.name: StatusSupplier
classes.description: A functional interface extending Supplier to provide a CompletionStage<JsonObject> representing system status.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletionStage<JsonObject> representing the current status.
